versions.changelog: 初始发布：A股/港股/美股行情、财务、板块、龙虎榜、涨停跌停、新股IPO、融资融券等150+接口，含个股查询规则
新增个股查询规则：禁止用全市场接口筛选个股，推荐使用 stock_bid_ask_em、stock_individual_info_em、stock_zh_a_hist 等个股专用接口
修复5个过时API，扩展至150+接口，新增港股美股支持

Initial release of AkShare A股量化数据分析工具.

- Provides extensive Python API interface to AkShare for A股、港股、美股行情、财务、板块、龙虎榜、资金流向等数据获取和分析
- Covers real-time and historical quotes, sector analysis, fund flows, financial reports, IPO/new stocks, and margin finance
- Supports querying for leaderboard stocks, price limits, shareholder and institutional data, market valuation, news, and research reports
- Includes usage notes for date/code formats, data volume, and interface performance
- Documentation contains categorized sample code for quick start and each data category
